svg.aria-label: The FM1 Tonic panel with its labels: knobs, buttons, black keys (TRACK 1-8, ACCENT, FILL, FUNC) and white keys (STEP 1-16)
svg.text: WHITE KEYS 1 TO 16 = STEPS 1 TO 16 FUNC + WHITE KEY = PATTERN 1 TO 16
WHITE KEY HELD + TURN K1-K4 = P-LOCK THAT STEP (SELECT = ITS CHANCE)
ENV + TURN = DEFAULT SAVE + TURN = FORGET MOTION REC + PLAY + TURN = RECORD
